spec.situation_desc: had a direct debit taken twice

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I’m Bartek Ndlovu. My direct debit to Northstar Energy has gone out twice, and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Bartek. I can understand why you’re frustrated, and I’ll take ownership of this. Before I look at anything on the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’ll check the duplicate payment now. I’m sure we’ll get the second payment refunded for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I hope so. It’s £86.40 twice, both showing as taken on Monday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the two £86.40 payments to Northstar Energy dated 19 October. I’ll log this as a complaint about the duplicate direct debit. Your complaint reference is TB-482731.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send this to our payments investigation team today and remain your point of contact. I’ll call you by 3 pm tomorrow with an update, even if they’re still looking into it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, and when will I get a proper answer?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response to your complaint within 15 business days. I’ll also make sure the investigation considers the duplicate payment and what should happen to it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: I’ve logged your complaint, I’m sending it to the payments team today, and I’ll call you by 3 pm tomorrow. You’ll have a full written response within 15 business days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Bartek. I’m sorry again for the hassle, and I’ll be in touch tomorrow.
